description: This Java source file defines the EmailUtils class which provides utility methods for creating email-related data structures, such as email template tokens, based on merchant store data. It primarily aids in generating standardized email content.

classes.name: EmailUtils
classes.description: A utility class for generating email content components such as template tokens based on merchant store data.

methods.name: createEmailObjectsMap
methods.description: Creates a map of email template tokens including store name, logo, and disclaimers, tailored for use in HTML email templates.
